message: The other day, I was in the kitchen multitasking like a pro—making dinner while keeping an eye on the kids. Suddenly, the smoke alarm chirped, and I realized I’d let the pasta boil a bit too long. Thankfully, I’d recently tested the alarm and made a little escape plan with the family, just in case. It felt good to know we were ready! Have you had any small wins like that in your home?
